item.title: Carly Pearce Signs With BBR Music Group/BMG Nashville
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to Trending on Billboard, your source for the latest music news. I'm your host, and today we're talking about country singer-songwriter Carly Pearce.
[Music transitions to a country tune]
Host: Carly Pearce has signed with BBR Music Group/BMG Nashville, joining their roster of talented artists. She was previously signed with Blue Highway, but now she's found a new home. Stoney Creek Records will serve as her radio imprint, and if you tune into country radio, you can hear her duet with Riley Green, "If I Don't Leave I'm Gonna Stay."
[Music transitions back to the intro tune]
Host: Pearce has had an impressive career so far, earning three Billboard Country Airplay No. 1 hits, including the Grammy-winning "Never Wanted To Be That Girl." She's been a BMG Publishing writer since 2015 and has recently signed with Scott Borchetta's Borchetta Entertainment Group for management.
[Music transitions to a live concert clip]
Host: You might have caught Carly Pearce performing at CMA Fest last week on the Nissan Stadium stage, or at Billboard Country Live, a two-day concert event in Nashville. She's been keeping busy, also performing at Spotify House and hosting her annual benefit for the CMA Foundation, Carly's Closet.
[Music transitions back to the intro tune]
Host: We heard from Carly Pearce herself, who said, "Signing with BMG feels less like turning a new page and more like finding the best next chapter." The team at BBR Music Group/BMG Nashville is excited to welcome her, with executive vp JoJamie Hahr saying, "Carly is one of the most authentic and compelling voices in our format."
[Music transitions to an outro tune]
Host: That's all for today. Thanks for tuning in to Trending on Billboard. We'll keep you updated on Carly Pearce's new chapter with BBR Music Group/BMG Nashville.
[Outro music continues to play until the end]
